title: Concept: File access built from input (swift) — review required
description: In swift, String(contentsOfFile: dir + f) builds a file path from input, so traversal sequences can step outside the intended directory. The remedy is confinement to a base directory (normalized prefix check) plus normalization and an allowlist.
applicability: swift file access; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Arbitrary file read or write; HIGH severity.
